Figure 2. Study design for evaluating age transfer in ECG conduction classification. An older-adult-trained model was evaluated without adaptation on an independent young-adult cohort. Pediatric experiments compared older-adult and young-adult fine-tuning with training from scratch using identical pediatric training patients. Five patient-level folds kept test patients separate from training, model selection, calibration, and threshold selection. Young-adult evaluation assessed direct transfer, while exploratory pediatric experiments assessed the benefit of adult pretraining.
